selector.rationale: The presence of nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis with a peripheral mantle zone surrounding a central germinal center, along with CD20 positive and BCL-2 negative cells, supports Cutaneous Lymphoid Hyperplasia as the most specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Photodermatitis
rejected.why: While phototest results show erythema after UV-A exposure, the skin biopsy and clinical presentation do not strongly support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Discoid Lupus Erythematosus
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy results do not align with typical findings of Discoid Lupus Erythematosus, such as the absence of characteristic discoid lesions and specific immunohistological markers.
